summary: Episode EP11 covers scenes sc_001 (cottage grounds, EP11:E1-E47) and sc_002 (interior, EP11:E48-E85). Source warnings state both scenes have incomplete coverage and gaps are unavailable, so the sequence and completeness of events are uncertain. The on-screen evidence shows Gerald arriving with a Constable, accusing Alexander of stealing his gold pocket watch, and demanding a search. The Constable searches the cottage, Gerald provokes Alexander, and the Constable finds a gold pocket watch in Alexander's trench coat (EP11:E78). Clarissa appears only briefly in the carriage (EP11:E12) and her role is not established on screen. Gerald's claim that the theft happened on his last visit (EP11:E20) is unverified within the supplied evidence. Metadata describing the logline and continuity is not on-screen evidence and is not used for any event claim. Speaker tags for EP11:E44, EP11:E72 and EP11:E74 are malformed, so the attribution of those lines is uncertain as written.

beats.description: Carriage arrives through muddy grounds; Gerald and an armed Constable step down while Juliana and Alexander watch with apprehension.
Gerald accuses Alexander of stealing his gold pocket watch on his last visit; Juliana disputes the claim.
Gerald insults Juliana and Alexander threatens him; the Constable demands a search and Alexander agrees to it.
The Constable ransacks the cottage while Juliana pleads and tries to save her mother's medicines and linens.
Gerald taunts Juliana and baits Alexander to strike; Alexander is restrained by the Constable's truncheon and holds back.
The Constable finds a gold pocket watch inside Alexander's coat; Juliana is horrified, Alexander realizes he has been framed, and Gerald gloats.

revelations.claim: A gold pocket watch with an attached chain is found inside the lining of Alexander's trench coat, supporting Gerald's accusation on screen.
creates_questions: Who placed the watch in Alexander's coat?
Did Alexander take the watch on Gerald's previous visit as claimed?
Did Gerald or Clarissa plant the watch?

revelations.claim: Clarissa is visibly pleased with the confrontation and Gerald reacts with triumph at the discovery, suggesting but not establishing coordination between them.
creates_questions: Was Clarissa involved in the frame-up?

unresolved_questions.question: Who planted the gold pocket watch in Alexander's coat and how did it get there?
Did Alexander ever take Gerald's watch during Gerald's previous visit to the cottage?
What role, if any, does Clarissa play in Gerald's accusation?
Will Alexander retaliate against Gerald or accept the consequences of the discovery?
Will Juliana's trust in Alexander survive the discovery of the watch?
